about: Effects for stat text the parser cannot model (R6), keyed by uniqueName (`#<perk>` for Incarnon perks, `#zoom` for a sniper's zoom bonus). `effects` (domain Effect fields) replace the parsed ones and set support to full unless `support` is given; `support` + `note` alone only adjust the status. Values come from the entry's own DE text or a saved wiki page named in `note`; never guessed. `text` is the entry's text the override was written for (mods: description + max-rank stats; perks: lines + notes; zoom: the zoom lines); when the text changes the override is switched off and listed by refresh, never applied to new text (G90 U2). Refresh fails on an entry that matches nothing or has no `text`.

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Zariman/Pistols/Hea.note: Laetum page, EVO5: '50% chance to deal +2000% damage on non-critical hits'; notes: multiplicative to base damage bonuses
text: 50% chance to deal +2000% damage on non-critical hits
Damage bonus is multiplicative to base damage bonuses such as Hornet Strike.

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Zariman/Pistols/Hea.note: Laetum page, EVO5: 'On Hit that is neither Critical nor applies a Status Effect: +400% damage for 10 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times'; notes: additive to base damage bonuses
text: On Hit that is neither Critical nor applies a Status Effect: +400% damage for 10 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.
Damage bonus is additive to base damage bonuses such as Hornet Strike.
When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.
